Annotation Interface ServiceConnection

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target({FIELD,METHOD,ANNOTATION_TYPE}) public @interface ServiceConnection
Indicates that a field or method is a ContainerConnectionSource which provides a service that can be connected to.

如果底层连接支持 SSL，可以使用 `@PemKeyStore`、@PemTrustStore、@JksKeyStore、@JksTrustStore 和 @Ssl 注解来提供额外的配置。

Since:
3.1.0
Author:
Moritz Halbritter, Andy Wilkinson, Phillip Webb

  • 元素详情

    • value

      @AliasFor("name") String value
      The name of the service being connected to. Container names are used to determine the connection details that should be created when a technology-specific Container subclass is not available.

      如果未指定且Container实例可用，则使用docker image name的repository部分。请注意，当容器在@Bean方法中定义时，Container实例在容器定义时还早不可用。所有需要在连接名称上进行匹配的@ServiceConnection@Bean方法必须声明此属性。

      此属性是name()的别名。

      Returns:
      服务名称
      See Also:
      • name()
      Default:
      ""
